answers.text: yes, moved aside on the owner's machine to `~/.agents/skills-disabled`; the caveman package stays excluded, see [docs/adr/0002-owner-decisions-2026-09-25.md](docs/adr/0002-owner-decisions-2026-09-25.md).

question: skills installed in `~/.agents/skills` load into every Codex session, and into every other harness that reads that folder, next to TAC's own. Move them aside while TAC runs?
recommendation: yes. The excluded caveman package stays excluded and its terse seed is dropped; the board does not reopen either.
